label: grants role
type: GRANT statement's core action - delegating a role to a user or group. Part of a small well-evidenced family with revokesRole/assignsRole/assignsToGroup/groupMembersInheritRole covering the Capella data-plane RBAC statement set (CREATE/DROP USER/GROUP, GRANT, REVOKE) deliberately targeted by this stress-test batch.
note: Individually low-recurrence but promoted as a family - see relations/revokes-role.json, assigns-role.json, assigns-to-group.json, group-members-inherit-role.json, and reconciliation.md.
